name: Aivo Tool Registration
description: Propose registering MCP tool sources and external Skill resources through exact Host confirmation. 对话式注册 MCP 工具来源和 Skill 资源。

tools.name: aivo_tools_register_mcp
tools.description: Propose and, only after exact native user approval, register one MCP tool source globally so later conversations can resolve it. Never put raw secrets in arguments; use bearerTokenEnv for an existing environment-variable reference. 对话式注册 MCP 工具来源。

description.description: Optional concise non-secret description of the complete capability this MCP source provides.

command.description: For stdio only: an absolute executable path or a simple executable name. No shell expression.

cwd.description: For stdio only: optional existing absolute working directory.

url.description: For HTTP/SSE only: HTTPS endpoint, or loopback HTTP for local development. User info, query, and fragment are refused.

items.description: Existing absolute local directory exposed as an MCP root.

bearerTokenEnv.description: Existing Host environment-variable name. Never provide its value.

tools.name: aivo_tools_register_resource
tools.description: Propose and, only after exact native user approval, install one external Agent Skill resource into Aivo-managed global Skill storage. Provide a stable skills.sh id/URL or a public GitHub repository URL plus an exact skill slug so the Host runs the skills CLI, imports the complete installed directory into Aivo, removes the ~/.agents staging copy, and refreshes Skill discovery; when providing files directly, include every file in the Skill folder, not only SKILL.md. 对话式安装完整 Skill 目录资源。

kind.description: Resource kind. Currently only Agent Skill directories are supported.

id.description: Stable resource id such as owner/repo/skill-name. Use only when it identifies one exact Skill.

source.description: Optional skills package source such as owner/repo; combined with skill when id is omitted.

skill.description: Optional Skill slug or name; combined with source when id is omitted.

url.description: Optional skills.sh URL identifying one Skill, or a GitHub repository URL combined with the exact skill slug. Pack and ambiguous repository URLs require a separate selection flow and are refused.

scope.description: Installation scope. Conversational registration currently installs global Skills.

files.description: Optional complete Skill file snapshot. Include every file in the Skill directory using relative paths; SKILL.md is required.
